scope: Table I and Eqs. (2), (14)–(18), (20), using the topology of Fig. 3, with numeric comparisons to Figs. 4, 5, 10 and 11.

assumptions.bases: Use balanced three-phase power and phase-peak voltage/current bases. Use rated active power also as the reactive power base.
assumptions.frequency: Baseline uses 314 rad/s and 12 mH from Table I. Independently repeat using its printed 0.5 pu and exact 50 Hz applied to 12 mH.
assumptions.gain_unit: The figure captions omit the conductance of the power-reference correction. Interpret Eq. (20) in W and V as primary; independently test the literal printed numbers as pu power per pu voltage.
assumptions.disturbance: Permanent balanced sag, nominal grid angle speed. Solve each configuration to its own prefault steady state. Voltage and current inner loops are ideal, with instantaneous Q–V droop and a delay-free threshold in Fig. 9.
assumptions.limits: Replay the power reference directly according to Eq. (20); firmware saturation, filtering and anti-windup settings are unavailable.
